description.en: The land south of the plain of Acre and the Jezreel valley, west of the Jordan and Dead Sea, from the sea to the desert and the Egypt road; al-Muqaddasi (985) also lists Jericho and Amman among its towns.
description.ar: الأرض جنوب سهل عكا ومرج ابن عامر، غرب الأردن والبحر الميت، من البحر إلى الصحراء وطريق مصر؛ ويذكر المقدسي (985) أيضًا أريحا وعمّان بين مدنها.
description.he: האדמה דרומית למישור עכו ולעמק יזרעאל, ממערב לירדן ולים המלח, מהים ועד המדבר ודרך מצרים; אל-מקדסי (985) מונה בין עריה גם את יריחו ואת עמאן.

sources.quote: which included all the countries lying to the south of the great plain of Acre and Esdraelon — to the west of the Jordan cleft and the Dead Sea
Its capital is Ar-Ramlah. Among its cities are: Bait-al-Makdis (Jerusalem), Bait Jibril, Ghazzah (Gaza)
covered the region south of the Jezreel Valley

notes.en: Boundaries shifted somewhat over four centuries; one slice used for this first pass. Le Strange says part of former Palaestina Tertia was counted in Filastin.
